alexae-sales: Quick heads up 1 Mosaic POC 1 procurement pushed a redline asking for a 20% escrow/holdback on the OF. They want explicit acceptance and escrow custody. Who can advise?
sam-se: We can accept milestone release but need clear measurables. Suggest smoke test + 95th pct latency <200ms + 40 sample QA pass.
tess-legal: Please avoid escrow language if possible 1 adds complexity. Prefer 'reserve payment' and tie release to Acceptance Checklist. Draft below.
tess-legal: "Reserve Payment: Customer may withhold up to 15% of fees pending completion of the Acceptance Checklist. Redwood will release reserved funds within 10 business days of mutual written acceptance. No third-party escrow required."
mike-proc: Finance will approve 15% with strict milestones. Who signs the OF from customer side? PO contact + Head of Procurement usually. We should do a single envelope to streamline.
alexae-sales: On our side AE (alexae-sales) + finance-ops@redwood. Can procurement spin up the DocuSign envelope?
mike-proc: Yes, we'll draft the envelope once legal confirms final clause. @tess-legal any objections?
tess-legal: Fine with 15%. Add fallback: if acceptance not agreed within 15 days, reserved funds release after 30 days of production traffic or upon mediation.
sam-se: I'll attach the one-page acceptance checklist to the envelope with named owners. Checklist includes the exact smoke test commands and sample set.
esign-bot: Draft envelope created: env_mosaic_1755 1 status draft 1 pending tess-legal review.
mike-proc: I'll add customer signer emails once alexae confirms. Also confirm billing: Mosaic asked Net45; sales committed Net30. Finance, any flexibility?
alexae-sales: I'll confirm with Mosaic. Plan: tess to paste final wording into OF, sam attach checklist, mike finalize envelope and add signers, I'll update customer and SFDC. Target send by EOD tomorrow.
tess-legal: Clause added to OF draft. Ping if customer insists on escrow 1 we'll counter with 15% reserve + checklist.
alexae-sales: Thanks all. I'll follow up with Mosaic for signer emails and confirm net terms. :white_check_mark:
